description: This file defines the PathPoint class, which models points and instructions (move, line, curve) for path-based animations in an Android application.

classes.name: PathPoint
classes.description: Represents a point in a path with associated operation (move, line, curve) and optional control points for curves.

methods.name: lineTo
methods.description: Creates a PathPoint that represents a straight line to the specified coordinates.

methods.name: curveTo
methods.description: Creates a PathPoint that represents a Bezier curve with specified control points ending at the given coordinates.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Creates a PathPoint that represents a move operation to the specified coordinates.
